data: A core library composed of numerous C++ source files was being built. The build failed because the function `connect_timeout` was called in `socket.cpp` but was not declared or defined in that scope.
A C++ core library was being built using CMake. The compilation failed because the function `connect_timeout` was not declared in the scope where it was called inside `socket.cpp`.

The build log documents the compilation of a core library component, specifically focusing on network sockets and connection pooling. The process failed because the function `connect_timeout` was used without being declared in the source file `socket.cpp`.
